articles.title: Insects once had 24 legs
articles.snippet: A many-legged creature from long ago helps fill a major gap in the fossil record — and hints at how today’s insects ended up with just six legs.
articles.summary: An ancient many-legged creature helps fill a major gap in the fossil record. This ancient animal also hints at how today's insects ended up with just six legs.

articles.title: Meet the first new living cat species described in more than a century
articles.snippet: Genetic tests on two of these teeny tiger cats, found in Bolivia, show they constitute a new species. They add a new branch to the feline family tree.
articles.summary: Genetic tests on two tiny tiger cats found in Bolivia show they are a completely new species. This discovery adds a new branch to the feline family tree for the first time in over a century.

articles.title: Hydrogels could help stop wildfires from reigniting, teens find
articles.snippet: The brothers custom built a nozzle to spray their fire-retardant hydrogels up to 60 feet.
articles.summary: Two teenage brothers custom-built a nozzle that can spray fire-retardant hydrogels up to 60 feet. This invention could help stop wildfires from reigniting.
